methods.responses: hierarchical empirical Bayes (lib/hierarchy.py) on lib/responses.leaf_sample, sampling error calibrated on the replicate deviations; legacy tables (within transformation, harvest-year clusters, Paule-Mandel, regional-v1) kept as benchmarks
methods.weights: Latest reported harvested area, or documented package-area share when absent, times the shared training-only ENSO-neutral baseline (lib/baseline.py); the same baseline rule is used in publication_run.py withheld-year folds.
methods.predictions: Fitted leaf-level exp(slope_eb * exposure) - 1, aggregated with fixed neutral production baselines; uncertainty draws do not change the headline. Central 80% (and separately 95%) ranges for the conditional ENSO-related effect. Shared harvest-year blocks, shrinkage error and finite-sample correction; forecast-input uncertainty in the medium scenario. No harvest residual. Not a full-harvest prediction interval.

replicates.interval: Central 80% (and separately 95%) ranges for the conditional ENSO-related effect. Shared harvest-year blocks, shrinkage error and finite-sample correction; forecast-input uncertainty in the medium scenario. No harvest residual. Not a full-harvest prediction interval.

validation_design.training: every other eligible harvest year; at least ten training years per series

conditional_skill.target: Known full-season ENSO, final-vintage yields; point-prediction skill of the displayed estimator versus the fitted trend (full-record leave-one-harvest-year-out of the teleconnected expansion).
conditional_skill.restriction: Never use as issued-forecast skill or a lead-specific deployment gate.

skill_gates.rule: usable where the lower 80 percent bound (skill_lo80) of the panel skill exceeds zero

definitions.skill: full-record leave-one-harvest-year-out, observed full-season relative Nino 3.4, final-vintage yields; equal-year mean squared error over the panel's series against the trend; skill_lo80/hi80 the 10th and 90th percentiles of 1,000 year resamples; one value for every lead (the index is known in full)
definitions.scenario_contrast: the expansion's conditional_scenarios (methods linear and final_selected) at relative-index values -1, 0, 1, 2; harvest_range80 renamed lo80/hi80; the exporter forms the central-path row
definitions.support: preferred (subnational) rows where they exist, else the national series
definitions.undefined: skill is null where the mean squared observed departure is below 1e-9 or |skill| exceeds 10 (constant or imputed yields)
definitions.exposure: scores use the growing-season relative index (n34rel_season); loyo_predictions also holds the middle3 rows

conditional_skill.target: Known full-season ENSO, final-vintage yields; point-prediction skill of the displayed estimator versus the fitted trend (full-record leave-one-harvest-year-out of the teleconnected expansion).
conditional_skill.restriction: Never use as issued-forecast skill or a lead-specific deployment gate.

model.central_estimate: fitted response; Monte Carlo draws quantify uncertainty
